en: ...What's wrong?

You came to invite me?
You're a weird one...
I wonder why Monokuma trapped us here?
I was looking for you. Well, are you free?
Spend time together
Never mind
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Maki?
Spend time together
Go on a date
Never mind
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What would you like to do with Maki?

...If you don't have any business with me,
shouldn't you spend time with the others?
Aren't you worried that I might kill you?

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time reassuring Maki
that I trust her.
Well, I'm not saying I *don't* want to.
But, that way of living is pretty tiring.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time telling Maki
about the way I live.

I've dealt with criminals before, but this is
the first time I've been unable to read someone.

Maybe I got caught in this mess, because of
my profession.

Oh, but...up until now, you've never done
anything dangerous, have you?

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time talking with Maki
about my life up until now.

I wasn't looking for you because of
anything serious...

I-I just wanted to hang out...
That's normal, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent a few minutes trying to convince
Maki not to be embarrassed...
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki and I grew a little closer today.
